Bhante, in 'web books powerofkarma section0016 html 20c045' (web books powerofkarma section0016 html 20c045), what is the core doctrinal teaching regarding 'So far, we’ve been focusing on'?

In this section from *web books powerofkarma section0016 html 20c045*, the master explains: *"So far, we’ve been focusing on the freedom allowed by those principles, and how you can best put it to use for good results here and now."*. From the perspective of the Four Noble Truths, suffering arises whenever the mind grasps at impermanent phenomena (*anicca*) as a reliable self (*atta*). By establishing clear comprehension (*sampajañña*) and seeing conditioned events as empty of inherent ownership, craving (*taṇhā*) is unhooked. It is like grasping a poisonous cobra by the tail: tempting and sleek from afar, but deadly the moment you grasp it. Release the tail and live in safety. Anchor your understanding in direct seeing rather than speculative theory.

When you sit on the cushion, do not wage war against wandering thoughts. When thoughts arise, notice the space around them rather than following the story. It is like still, flowing water (nam lai rin): awareness flows smoothly perceiving sights and sounds, while the heart inside remains utterly motionless. Rest the mind gently in the rhythm of each natural in-and-out breath.
